why: After a full pass through the playground the owner said: 'I didn't see much regarding page controls at the top or sidebar, which shutterflow will heavily need; also this whole side peek and panel, I saw nothing.' A code read says v3 ships nearly all of it and the playground hides it. PageBar controls, FilterSet (src/controls/filter-set.tsx), ViewTabs (src/controls/view-tabs.tsx), Segmented and DateRangePicker (src/ui), PageAside (src/page/page-aside.tsx) with the AppShell aside region (src/shell/app-shell.tsx:171-262), Peek and usePeek (src/page/peek.tsx, src/router/peek.ts), SplitPage and ResizablePanelGroup (src/ui/resizable.tsx) all exist. But /overview (FilterSet, ViewTabs, PageBar controls) is in no nav destination; recipes/view-switch.tsx, saved-views.tsx and two-pane.tsx are rendered by no route; Segmented, DateRangePicker and ResizablePanelGroup have no demo at all; the aside demos sit under 'Fleet (shell cycle N)' and 'dogfood' labels, and /shell's aside body is one sentence (apps/playground/src/routes/shell.tsx:9-10); Peek opens only from a record link on Home. apps/playground/src/demo/nav-model.tsx is the single place destinations are stated. The owner judges the kit by this app, and so will an agent that reads it as the reference.
what: apps/playground only: the nav model, new routes, and demo data. No package change.
owns: apps/playground/src/routes/** (new gallery routes; existing routes only to link them)
change: Give the nav a 'Kit' group ahead of the cycle and scenario groups, one destination per capability, each a realistic page and not a one-line stub: (1) page controls: a records page with PageBar tabs, FilterSet with text, enum, Segmented and DateRangePicker controls, ViewTabs switching table and cards, and saved views; (2) the aside as an inspector beside a list, with real content (fields, a chart, actions), opened by selecting a row, at every aside width the shell ships; (3) Peek over a list and over a chart mark, with keyboard next and previous; (4) SplitPage list and detail; (5) ResizablePanelGroup; (6) one composed reference page in the shape a media or records app needs: controls on top, a filter panel at the side, a result grid, peek on a result and the aside for its details. Route the three unrouted recipes. Move the cycle and scenario groups below and label them as trial evidence. While building, write docs/v3/verdicts/showcase-gaps.md: every place the shipped surface could not do what the page needed (for example controls living in a side panel, a resizable aside: the shell fixes it at 320/360/480/640 by decision DPO 17 in docs/v3/concepts/shell-nav-router.md:37, an image grid), each with the file it would land in. Do not build around a gap with page-local markup or a waiver: leave it visibly missing and list it. File nothing yourself; the list is for the owner.
acceptance: Every capability in the list above is reachable in one click from the nav and renders a page with real content (a route test per destination)
No route under the Kit group has an oxlint waiver and `bun run lint` is at 0 findings
recipes/view-switch.tsx, saved-views.tsx and two-pane.tsx are each rendered by a route
docs/v3/verdicts/showcase-gaps.md lists each gap with the capability, what was tried and the package file it belongs to, or says none
The quality matrix and layout suite pass on the new routes at 390 and 1800
out_of_scope: Any package change; the page top look (v3-owner-1-page-top restyles PageBar underneath these pages); filing follow-up Issues.
proof: make check; shots of each Kit destination at 1800 and 390, light and dark, in the PR.
commits: feat: per gallery page; docs: the gaps page.
note: Source: the owner's first hands-on review of the v3 playground on 2026-11-18. He asked for the root cause to be fixed, not the page he named. File citations come from a code read on that date at master 7c454b3a0 and were not run in a browser: confirm each before building on it.
